what_this_is: configs/baseline/e21-buf90-zero-locked-scored4.json -- the sealed SAEA-E21-FULL44-DIRECT-BASELINE-V2 arm -- with THREE keys added and NONE changed. Every other value is byte for byte the sealed fragment's, so the instruction, the arm, the policy, the evidence source, the retry and skip bounds and the batch geometry are the comparator's. The single factor is the TRANSPORT UNIT: instead of cutting ceil(D/90) fixed 90-second windows off the clock, the OBS loop cuts the call into the hash-pinned v2 plan's speaker-turn units -- 5,122 over the 44 calls against 1,593 windows -- each of which never crosses a diarized speaker change EXCEPT through the v2 minimum-duration merge, never ends inside active speech where a pause of at least 300 ms sits within 2.0 s of the turn change, is capped at 90 s, and is at least 1.0 s (a span under 1.0 s merges into whichever adjacent unit is longer, of either speaker, or is kept and flagged if neither admissible neighbour fits the cap -- zero remain kept on this plan).
why_the_window_keys_stay: obs_buffer_seconds 90 and the advance keys are left at the sealed values rather than removed, and that is deliberate: under a unit plan they are inert (the plan supplies every unit position), and deleting them would make this fragment differ from the comparator's in keys the cell does not vary. obs_buffer_seconds also remains the cap the plan itself was cut under, so the two numbers cannot silently disagree. obs_boundary_mode stays 'fixed' because the plan fixes every position before the first contact -- which is exactly the independence condition from_values already requires for obs_batch_slices > 1, so slice batching stays legal.
plan_pin_basis: obs_unit_plan_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the committed plan file, and the seam must refuse to load a plan whose bytes disagree with it. The plan itself is model-free (exposure row SAEA-E21-MF-SPEAKER-TURN-UNITS-V2, receipt docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-08-e21-speaker-turn-units-v2/): it was cut from the anonymous segments of SAEA-E21-TOOL-DIARIZATION-V1 and an energy-based pause detector over the sealed obs-slices of the comparator's own attempt -- the same two sealed inputs v1 used -- it tiles every call, and its per-unit reference-word attribution sums to the sealed 359,765 exactly without opening a transcript.
tail_basis: obs_slice_tail_silence_seconds 2.0 is the knob wt/ts2y adds, REUSED and not re-implemented -- the admitted Earnings-22 convention, appended by reproduction.obs_audio.encode_slice to the delivered bytes only. The cut, the span and SliceRecord.start_seconds/end_seconds/audio_seconds are untouched (core.model.SliceRegistry.register requires audio_seconds to equal the span, which is what would refuse a seam that moved a cut). Delivered audio is 141,345.853 s of cut plus 5,122 x 2.0 s of tail = 151,589.853 s.
scorer_basis: All seven are declared so every number the preregistration's decision rule reads comes out of core.scoring_batch's verified path over ONE complete manifest, never an out-of-band read -- the same reasoning the sealed experiment fragment gives for adding asr-wer-whisper and entity-wer. The comparator's own three post-hoc agentic metrics were measured on its sealed outputs on 2026-09-06, so all four are known to succeed on this carrier. Scoring is post-hoc over recorded outputs and moves no request byte.
why_a_separate_baseline_fragment: Each cell's composed config_hash -- and therefore its protocol_hash and its exposure row -- must be movable only by an edit to ITS OWN fragments. Sharing the sealed comparator's fragment would mean a later clarification written for this cell silently changed the identity of the sealed 2026-09-04 comparator's composition.
